story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: New enrollment uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date
gaps: Description: "Verify the transaction effective date for a future new enrollment is driven by the Eligibility Date and is not changed by the Maintenance Date in Loop 2000 DTP*303." contradicts hint "Maintenance Date = Loop 2000 DTP*303." because the scenario scope is "Validate that for an inbound EDI 834 new enrollment whose member eligibility span has not yet begun, Facets populates the transaction effective date from Eligibility Date = Loop 2000 DTP*356/DTP*348 and not from Assessment Date = Loop 2300 HD03, regardless of Assessment Date value."

Pre-condition: "Prepare one unique inbound 834 enrollment file with member SSN [TEST DATA: member SSN used in the mocked 834 file], Eligibility Date 2025-01-31 in Loop 2000 DTP*356/DTP*348, Maintenance Date 2025-01-20 in Loop 2000 DTP*303, and Assessment Date 2025-01-24 in Loop 2300 HD03." is outside the scenario's quoted requirement "Facets populates the transaction effective date from Eligibility Date = Loop 2000 DTP*356/DTP*348 and not from Assessment Date = Loop 2300 HD03, regardless of Assessment Date value."

Test Case Name: "Verify AR PASSE new enrollment creates the required member and eligibility records in FACETS for the future Eligibility Date" is outside the scenario requirement "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the member’s eligibility span has not yet begun, the Eligibility Date (DTP*356/DTP*348) populates as the transaction effective date."

Description: "Verify a successful AR PASSE new enrollment with a future Eligibility Date creates the expected member and eligibility records in FACETS and associates them through the correct keys." does not cover the scenario clause "Facets populates the transaction effective date from Eligibility Date = Loop 2000 DTP*356/DTP*348 and not from Assessment Date = Loop 2300 HD03, regardless of Assessment Date value."

Test Case Name: "Verify AR PASSE new enrollment is fully traceable from archive and TM to EDIStageArchive records" is outside the scenario requirement "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the member’s eligibility span has not yet begun, the Eligibility Date (DTP*356/DTP*348) populates as the transaction effective date."

Description: "Verify the submitted AR PASSE 834 new enrollment can be traced consistently across file archive, TM, and the EDIStageArchive Interchange, FunctionalGroup, TransactionSet, and Member tables." does not cover the scenario clause "Facets populates the transaction effective date from Eligibility Date = Loop 2000 DTP*356/DTP*348 and not from Assessment Date = Loop 2300 HD03, regardless of Assessment Date value."

scenarios.title: Current eligibility with changed Assessment Date uses Assessment Date
gaps: TC_002 is the closest related case, but the scenario also requires "Maintenance Date = Loop 2000 DTP*303." from scenario description "Facets populates the transaction effective date from Assessment Date rather than Eligibility Date = Loop 2000 DTP*356/DTP*348 or Maintenance Date = Loop 2000 DTP*303."; add a dedicated test case for it

Duplicate intent with TC_005: both validate that Assessment Date still drives the transaction effective date when other inbound dates differ in value. TC_004 Expected Result: "SBEL_EFF_DT = 2025-06-29, confirming the effective date loaded matches the shared inbound date value." TC_005 Expected Result: "SBEL_EFF_DT = 2025-12-31 and does not equal 2025-01-31 or 2025-02-15, confirming the later changed Assessment Date drives the loaded effective date."

Duplicate intent with TC_004: both validate that Assessment Date still drives the transaction effective date when other inbound dates differ in value. TC_005 Expected Result: "SBEL_EFF_DT = 2025-12-31 and does not equal 2025-01-31 or 2025-02-15, confirming the later changed Assessment Date drives the loaded effective date." TC_004 Expected Result: "SBEL_EFF_DT = 2025-06-29, confirming the effective date loaded matches the shared inbound date value."

scenarios.title: Assessment Date change with no relevant field changes preserves field values and uses Assessment Date

flagged.why: missing case for one relevant field

gaps: Scenario clause missing coverage: "Aid Category" from scenario Description "Validate that when Assessment Date = Loop 2300 HD03 changes and the complete relevant-field set remains unchanged—Assessment Number, Assessment Tier, Assessment Division, Aid Category, Rate Cell, Pregnancy—Facets uses Assessment Date as the transaction effective date and maintains the existing values of those listed fields." Attach to TC_001 as most related case: TS_003 also requires "Aid Category"; add a dedicated test case for it

scenarios.title: Future eligibility with unchanged Assessment Date and changed listed fields uses Eligibility Date
Current eligibility with unchanged Assessment Date and changed listed fields uses Maintenance Date

flagged.why: missing dedicated cases for named fields

gaps: Coverage gap attached to TC_007: scenario description requires "any of the complete listed fields change—Assessment Number, Assessment Tier, Assessment Division, Aid Category, Rate Cell, Pregnancy"; add a dedicated test case for it beyond the grouped case "change Assessment Number, Assessment Tier, Assessment Division, Aid Category, Rate Cell, and Pregnancy in the same transaction."

Semantic duplicate: Test Case Name "Verify AR PASSE inbound 834 does not rely on unresolved crosswalk or MELC validation for this Maintenance Date rule and completes with core stage and Facets evidence" shares the same business intent as the field-specific cases: validate that current eligibility + unchanged Assessment Date + changed listed field uses Maintenance Date.

scenarios.title: First occurrence of repeated inbound dates is used for transaction effective date logic
gaps: Scenario TS_006 also requires "Validate that when multiple occurrences of the same inbound date type are present, the logic uses the first occurrence of Eligibility Date = Loop 2000 DTP*356/DTP*348, the first occurrence of Assessment Date = Loop 2300 HD03, or the first occurrence of Maintenance Date = Loop 2000 DTP*303, consistent with the applicable business rule for selecting the transaction effective date in Facets."; add a dedicated test case for it
Semantic duplicate with TC_006: both validate that repeated Assessment Date content results in only the first date being used as the transaction effective date in Facets.

scenarios.title: Regression confirms Maintenance Date is not used outside specified rule and finance-impact behavior is corrected
gaps: Coverage gap attached to TC_002: scenario description says "Confirm that Maintenance Date is only used when specified in acceptance criteria.", but there is no dedicated positive test for the acceptance-criteria clause "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the member’s eligibility span has already begun and any relevant fields have changed but Assessment Date has NOT changed, the Maintenance Date (DTP*303) populates as the transaction effective date." Add a dedicated test case for it.
